Core parts of the game state are deliberately randomized, producing large systemic changes rather than a conventional political or economic incident.

Extraterrestrial or non-human invasion forces directly threaten countries, territory, and the existing international order.
States rapidly acquire the doctrine, strategic weapons, equipment, fortifications, institutions, and military capacity needed for future conflict.

After a successfully fired ordinary minor event at Chaos Tier 3 or above, Random Stuff gets a rare dynamic activation roll. On success it uniformly draws 3 to 5 additional events without replacement from the entire currently fireable positive-weight event pool, ignoring major or minor type, severity, and weight magnitude. Its chance starts at 0.30%, 0.60%, or 0.85% by tier, rises gradually after valid misses, can exceed 1% during a long dry streak, and uses a 240-day successful cooldown.
